name: test-plan
description: 基于已确认的 spec.md 生成 checklist 形式的 test-plan.md。每条验收项必须用 `- [ ] cmd:` 或 `- [ ] human:` 之一明确标记，供 Verification 阶段两段式判定。用户确认后方可进入 Tasking。

prompt.instruction: Read every AC-N and FR-N from spec.md. For each, derive one or more checklist items that prove or disprove it. Use exactly two prefixes — '- [ ] cmd: <shell>' for items a shell can verify by exit-code, and '- [ ] human: <description>' for items requiring human judgement. Organize items into groups labelled G1, G2, ... with a one-line 'Pass criterion' summary at the end of each group. The very last item of the document MUST be 'cmd: tail -n 1 verification.log | grep -q "ALL PASSED"'.
guardrails: Each checklist line MUST start with either '- [ ] cmd:' or '- [ ] human:' — no other prefixes are valid.
cmd: items must be runnable in the targetDir working directory without sudo and without network.
Each group must end with a 'Pass criterion' line so report aggregation works.
Cover every AC-N from spec.md with at least one checklist item.
Include cross-cutting concerns: file/dir existence (cmd), JSON schema validity (cmd), schema/DAG invariants (human), UX behaviours (human).
